summaryZh: Fraley实验室研究正常及癌细胞如何迁移，以寻找针对迁移行为的治疗策略。团队构建接近生理环境的三维体外组织，开发物理和分子过程测量工具，并发展用于血流及肺部感染检测的分子诊断技术。
researchQuestions: 癌细胞如何在细胞外基质环境中迁移，能否阻止这一过程？
methods: 三维体外组织环境工程
物理与分子过程测量工具开发

evidence.quote: The Fraley lab seeks to advance understanding of how cancer cells migrate with the goal of developing new treatment strategies targeting metastasis

By studying cell-extracellular matrix interactions, engineering physiologically relevant tissue environments "in a dish", and developing new tools and techniques to measure the physical and molecular processes cancer cells use to move through such environments
The lab is also advancing cancer prevention by developing technologies to democratize the ability to test for known and novel infectious diseases
Stephanie I. Fraley is an Associate Professor of Bioengineering at the University of California, San Diego.
The Fraley lab seeks to advance understanding of how normal and cancerous cells migrate

We approach this goal by engineering physiologically relevant 3D tissue contexts "in a dish" and developing new tools and techniques to measure the physical and molecular processes cells use to move through such environments.

We have innovated in the molecular diagnostics space to develop faster, less expensive, more se nsitive technologies, which have recently been applied to improve the detection of bloodstream and lung infections.
